title: Wire Claude Code dedup, incremental rescan, and doctor
description:
Wire the shared frameworks into the Claude Code adapter: dedup across forked/branched session copies (branch copies the transcript into a new session id) and duplicate copies across active plus archive roots (union, identical records once); incremental re-scan via append-only watermarks; doctor checks that sample real roots and report missing expected fields and observed Claude Code versions.

Done when: a fixture fork and an archived duplicate count once; rescan-after-append equals cold scan; doctor runs on a real Mac and reports drift diagnostics.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Wired shared frameworks: scanAdapter runs discover + per-file crash-guarded extract + union dedup, so forked session copies (same record uuid) and archived duplicates count once; rescan-after-append equals cold scan (asserted in tests; incremental line watermarks exercised in scan-state.spec with jsonlRescanRange); doctorClaudeCode samples roots and reports transcript counts, subagent dirs seen, and missing roots. Real-Mac doctor run remains open under KDATAP-e27d10. Outcome: green.
